"""Camera-guided controller; all observations and submitted commands are recorded locally.
Uses only the public robot client, RGB-D calibration, and proprioception.
Job files in jobs/ are the ordered, reviewable control program for this episode.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, json, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
ROOT=Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
seq=0

def state(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
def snap(name):
    obs.save(str(ROOT/name))
    print(name, 'state',state()[:13], 'eef',state()[26:29], 'time',obs.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
def run(q=None,grip=-1,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1,n=40,name='move'):
    global obs,seq
    start=state()[4:11]
    if q is None:q=start
    A=np.zeros((n,13)); A[:,:7]=np.linspace(start,q,n); A[:,7]=grip; A[:,12]=mode
    if base is not None:A[:,8:11]=base
    A[:,11]=torso
    np.save(ROOT/f'actions_{seq:03d}.npy',A)
    obs=r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=name)
    seq+=1;snap(name)
def observe(name='obs',seconds=0):
    global obs
    obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none',seconds=seconds);snap(name)
def point(cam,u,v):
    c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']); d=obs.depth[cam][-1] if obs.depth[cam].ndim==3 else obs.depth[cam]
    z=float(d[v,u]); return T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z])
def pose():
    return state()[26:29].copy(),np.array(obs.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
snap('current')
(ROOT/'jobs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for i in range(1000):
    p=ROOT/'jobs'/f'{i:03d}.py'
    while not p.exists():time.sleep(.1)
    print('JOB',i,flush=True)
    try: exec(compile(p.read_text(),str(p),'exec'),globals())
    except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
    (ROOT/f'done_{i:03d}').touch()
